fresh_response_validity.note: Fixed realistic suite; each prompt is sent once as a cold response. Do not average synthetic repeated prompts, warmed continuations, or n-gram/history-accelerated rows into this metric.

realistic_final_gate.chunk_count_matches_completion_tokens_no: Informational only: llama.cpp usage may count an EOS/final token that is not emitted as a text delta. Promotion requires enough streamed text deltas to measure the first metric window.
realistic_final_gate.metric_name_note: Historical compatibility field: 100 timestamped token events divided by the first-to-100th event span (99 intervals).
realistic_final_gate.required_policy: fixed realistic prompt suite; each prompt once; cached_tokens=0 every row; no repeated/warmed prompt averaging; metric is median tokens 1-100 after TTFT

suite.description: Frozen cold-response suite for the Muse Glimmer 30B Q8 WOQ TP4 engineering and LocalMaxxing gate. The first 12 prompts are the established generic realistic suite; the final three preserve the Muse prose, code, and structured-output campaign anchors. Each prompt is sent exactly once.
suite.metric: median conventional throughput across the 99 inter-token intervals between generated-token events 1 and 100 after TTFT
